name: Driftline Coffee
purpose: Online storefront for a small coffee roaster: catalog of coffees with photos and prices, cart, checkout, and per-customer order history.
actors: Guest customer (browses, buys without an account)

entities.name: Product
relationships: has many order items and cart items

entities.name: CartItem
relationships: belongs to a cart session and a product

entities.name: Order
relationships: belongs to a customer (optional for guests)

entities.name: OrderItem
relationships: belongs to an order and a product

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: Guests see the product grid with photos, roast profiles, and prices

workflows.name: Add to cart
workflows.description: Add coffees with quantity; cart persists per session

workflows.name: Checkout
workflows.description: Guest-first: collect email, run server-authoritative pricing through the local payment simulator (Stripe-ready), show receipt via signed expiring link

workflows.name: View past orders
workflows.description: Registered customers sign in and see their order history with statuses

workflows.name: Admin manage store
workflows.description: Admin CRUDs products and views incoming orders

seed_demo: Six to eight coffees (single origin + blends) with photos, roast profile, tasting notes, and prices; one sample registered customer with a couple of past orders at various statuses so order history is visible immediately.
